## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-revenue-history`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-revenue-history -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `revenue-history.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `revenue-history.jsonl`

# revenue-history

> **Start here — free verify:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) (or the free MCP tool `verify_card` at `https://councilof.ai/mcp`) · **Full catalog:** [https://councilof.ai/catalog.json](https://councilof.ai/catalog.json) · Methodology: [https://councilof.ai/methodology/](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · Measurement, not certification.

One row per UTC day, read from `GET https://councilof.ai/api/revenue` by a loop on the RunPod pod
(`scripts/pod-loops/revenue-snapshot.sh` in CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai). Nothing typed by hand; every field is
the endpoint's own. `null` means no source, never 0.

## `one_number` — definition, verbatim from the endpoint

> Count of distinct payer wallets, excluding payTo and X402_SELF_WALLETS, across facilitator-confirmed settlements THAT MOVED A NON-ZERO AMOUNT. A wallet we control paying us is recorded but is neither revenue nor a buyer, and neither is a wallet that paid nothing: a settlement of zero is not a purchase.

`one_number.all_time` / `last_30d` are that count; `settlements`, `self_settlements`, `zero_value_settlements`
and `records_unreadable` are reported beside it so a reader can see what was excluded and why.

Measurement, not certification. Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677). Aggregate-only, no per-user data.
